roots.origin: 拉丁语 merx（属格 mercis：货物）；mercari 是「做买卖」，merces 是「报酬、恩惠」——同一批货，看的是它换来什么
roots.core_concept: goods put out to be exchanged / 摆出来供交换的那批东西
roots.core_image: 布摊在地上，货一样样码开，等着有人过来问价

roots.origin: 拉丁语 maritus（有配偶的、丈夫），maritare 表「使成配偶」；经古法语 marier 入英语
roots.core_concept: two joined into one household by vow / 一纸约把两人并成一户
roots.core_image: 两个名字并排写在同一张纸上，底下按了两个手印

roots.origin: 拉丁语 medius（居中的）；medianus 经古法语 moien 派出 mean 一支，medialia（挂在中间的饰片）派出 medal
roots.core_concept: the point standing between two ends / 站在两头之间的那一点
roots.core_image: 一根杆两头各压一物，手指在中间那点托住，杆不偏不倒

roots.origin: 拉丁语 mens（属格 mentis：心、脑子里想事情那一处）；mentio 是把心里那件事说出口，commentum 是心里琢磨出来的一套说法
roots.core_concept: the inner place where thinking happens / 脑子里琢磨事情的那一处
roots.core_image: 眼睛没看什么，人却坐着不动，事情在里头翻来翻去
roots.english_definition: the mind, the faculty of thinking

roots.origin: 拉丁语 mergere（按下去、没入水中），过去分词 mersus；emergere 是从水里冒出来，immergere 是按进水里去
roots.core_concept: going down under a surface until it is no longer told apart / 没到面下去，直到分不出来
roots.core_image: 一块布按进水盆，水面合上，布的边缘就找不着了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 gnoscere / noscere（认下来、知道），古形带 g-；ignorare 是认不出来，nobilis 本义是可认得出的、有名的
roots.core_concept: coming to know a thing well enough to recognize it / 认得出这是什么
roots.core_image: 远处一个身影走近，到面前才认出是谁
roots.english_definition: to come to know, to recognize

roots.origin: 拉丁语 negare（说不、否认），由 nec（不）与「说」合成；denegare 加 de- 加重语气，经古法语 denier 入英语；negativus 是「说不」那一路
roots.core_concept: saying no to what is put forward / 对递上来的那件事说不
roots.core_image: 一张纸推到面前，那人手一挡，头摇了一下

roots.origin: 拉丁语 nutrire（喂奶、养大），nutrix 是奶妈；经古法语 norrice（奶妈）与 norrir（喂养）一支入英语
roots.core_concept: feeding a small thing so it grows / 一口口喂下去，让小的长起来
roots.core_image: 一勺一勺送到嘴边，人小小的，一天天见长

roots.origin: 拉丁语 labi（脚下一滑、往下溜），过去分词 lapsus；elabi 是溜走，collabi 是一起往下溜
roots.core_concept: sliding down out of one's hold / 手没握住，一路往下溜
roots.core_image: 攥着的东西一点点往下滑，等发觉时手里已经空了

words.root_logic: merx（货）→ mercatus（交易、集市）→ 摆货交换的那个场
words.origin: 古北法语 market ← 拉丁语 mercatus（买卖、集市）← mercari ← merx（货）
words.native_definition: a place where goods are bought and sold; demand for something
words.core_concept: the ground where sellers lay out and buyers walk through – 卖的人摆开、买的人穿行的那片地
words.core_image: 一早地上就摊满了，人挨着货走，边看边问
examples: She sells eggs at the market.
There is no market for that.
semantic_expansions: 市场/集市：摆货交换的那片场地
行情：某样货在那片场上换得动多少
words.recall_hint: merx（货）→ mercatus（集市）→ 摆货交换的场

words.root_logic: merx（货）→ mercatans（做买卖的）→ 靠贩货为业的人
words.origin: 古法语 marchant ← 通俗拉丁语 mercatans ← mercari（买卖）← merx（货）
words.native_definition: a person who buys and sells goods, especially in large amounts
words.core_concept: the one who owns neither field nor workshop, only the goods in transit – 既不种地也不开工坊，手里只有在途那批货的人
words.core_image: 他自己不做也不种，一船拉进来，一船运出去
semantic_expansions: 商人/批发商：靠买进卖出货物为业的人
words.recall_hint: merx（货）→ mercatans → 靠贩货为业的人

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ merce（货）→ 众人拿货互换 → 商业
words.origin: 法语 commerce ← 拉丁语 commercium（贸易）← com＋merx（货）
words.native_definition: the buying and selling of goods on a large scale
words.core_concept: goods moving between many hands, not just two – 货在许多手之间流转，不止两方对换
words.core_image: 船进港、车出城，货一批批换了主人又往前走
semantic_expansions: 商业/贸易：众人拿货互换、货在多手间流转
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ merce（货）→ 众人拿货互换

words.root_logic: merces（报酬、恩惠）← merx（货）→ 不索价而给的那份 → 宽恕
words.origin: 古法语 merci ← 拉丁语 merces（报酬、恩惠）← merx（货）；由「该收的价」转指「不收价而施的恩」
words.native_definition: kindness shown in not punishing someone as much as one could
words.core_concept: the payment owed but not collected – 该收的那笔，收方却不要了
words.core_image: 账本上写着数目，那人把本子合上，说不必了
semantic_expansions: 仁慈/宽恕/怜悯：该收的那笔不收了，即不索价而施的恩
words.recall_hint: merces（报酬）← merx（货）→ 该收却不收的那份

words.root_logic: maritare（使成配偶）→ 把两人并成一户
words.origin: 古法语 marier ← 拉丁语 maritare（嫁娶）← maritus（配偶）
words.native_definition: to become the husband or wife of someone
words.core_concept: the moment two names go onto one paper – 两个名字落到同一张纸上那一刻
words.core_image: 他们在那张纸上依次签了名，回身时已是一户
semantic_expansions: 结婚/娶/嫁：把两人并成一户这个动作
words.recall_hint: maritare（使成配偶）→ 把两人并成一户

words.root_logic: marry（结婚）+ -age → 结成一户这件事，及此后那个关系
words.origin: 古法语 mariage ← 通俗拉丁语 maritaticum ← maritus（配偶）
words.native_definition: the legal union of two people; the state of being married
words.core_concept: the arrangement that holds after the paper is signed – 纸签完之后一直立着的那层关系
words.core_image: 那张纸收进抽屉，往后几十年都按它上面的算
examples: The marriage took place in June.
semantic_expansions: 婚姻：纸签完后一直立着的那层关系
结婚：签那张纸的那一场
结合：两者并成一体，泛用
words.recall_hint: marry（结婚）+ -age → 结成一户这件事及其关系

words.root_logic: marry（结婚）+ -ed → 已经并成一户的
words.origin: 英语 married，来自 marry ← 拉丁语 maritare ← maritus
words.native_definition: having a husband or wife
words.core_concept: the state of already being on that one paper – 名字已经在那张纸上的状态
words.core_image: 他左手无名指上有一圈没晒到的白痕
examples: They have been married ten years.
She is married to a doctor.
semantic_expansions: 已婚的：名字已经在那张纸上的状态
words.recall_hint: marry（结婚）+ -ed → 已经并成一户的

words.root_logic: marit（配偶）+ -al（…的）→ 与婚姻有关的
words.origin: 拉丁语 maritalis（属于配偶的）← maritus（配偶）
words.native_definition: relating to marriage or to being married
words.core_concept: belonging to what that one paper set up – 属于那张纸所立起来的那层关系
words.core_image: 表格上有一栏专问这一项，只能填其中一个选项
semantic_expansions: 婚姻的/夫妻的：属于那纸所立起的那层关系
words.recall_hint: marit（配偶）+ -al → 与婚姻有关的

words.root_logic: medianus（居中的）→ 居于目的与人之间的那个中介 → 手段
words.origin: 古法语 moiens（中介、方法）← 晚期拉丁语 medianus（居中的）← medius
words.native_definition: a method for achieving something; money and resources
words.core_concept: whatever stands between you and what you want – 横在人与所求之间、借它过去的那个
words.core_image: 河隔在中间，那条船就是过去的唯一凭借
semantic_expansions: 手段/方法：横在人与所求之间、借它达成的那个
财力：同样是借以办事的那份凭借
words.recall_hint: medianus（居中）→ 居于人与所求之间的中介

words.root_logic: mean（居中）+ time（时候）→ 两件事之间那段时候
words.origin: 英语复合词 mean＋time；mean ← 古法语 moien ← 拉丁语 medianus ← medius
words.native_definition: the period between two events
words.core_concept: the stretch that sits between one thing ending and the next starting – 一件事完与下一件起之间那一段
words.core_image: 前一场散了，后一场还没开，中间那阵子人都在门口站着
examples: In the meantime, please wait here.
He read a book in the meantime.
semantic_expansions: 其间/同时：一事完与下一事起之间那一段时候
words.recall_hint: mean（居中）+ time（时候）→ 两事之间那段时候

words.root_logic: medialia（挂在胸前正中的饰片）← medius（居中）→ 奖牌
words.origin: 法语 médaille ← 意大利语 medaglia ← 通俗拉丁语 medalia ← 拉丁语 medius（居中）
words.native_definition: a flat piece of metal given as an award
words.core_concept: the disc hung at the middle of the chest for all to see – 挂在胸前正中、供人看见的那枚扁片
words.core_image: 带子从颈后绕过来，那枚圆片正落在胸口中间
semantic_expansions: 奖牌/勋章：挂在胸前正中、供人看见的那枚扁片
words.recall_hint: medialia（挂在正中的饰片）← medius（居中）

words.root_logic: ment（心、思想）+ -al（…的）→ 属于脑子里那一处的
words.origin: 拉丁语 mentalis ← mens（心、思想）
words.native_definition: relating to the mind or to processes of thinking
words.core_concept: belonging to what happens inside the head, not outside it – 属于头脑里那一摊，不在外头
words.core_image: 他没动笔也没出声，两个数在脑子里就对上了
semantic_expansions: 精神的：属于脑子里那一处而非身体的
心理的：脑子里那一处的活动与状态
智力的：脑子里那一处运转的能力
words.recall_hint: ment（心）+ -al → 属于脑子里那一处的

words.root_logic: mens（心）→ mentio（把心里的事说出来）→ 顺口带出一句
words.origin: 拉丁语 mentio（说起、提名）← mens（心、想到的事）
words.native_definition: to speak or write about something briefly
words.core_concept: letting a thing in the head out in one short phrase – 把心里那件事只用一句放出来
words.core_image: 聊别的时候顺口带出一句，说完就往下说了
examples: She made no mention of it.
semantic_expansions: 提到/提及：心里那件事出口一句，不展开
说起：同一动作，重在开口带出
words.recall_hint: mens（心）→ mentio（说出心里的事）→ 顺口一句带出

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ ment（心、想）→ 心里琢磨出的话摆到那件事旁边
words.origin: 拉丁语 commentum（想出来的东西、注解）← comminisci（琢磨出来）← mens（心）
words.native_definition: a remark expressing an opinion about something
words.core_concept: the thought worked out and set beside the thing – 琢磨出来的那点想法，摆在那件事旁边
words.core_image: 书页边上留着几行小字，是读的人自己添的
examples: He made no comment on it.
semantic_expansions: 评论：琢磨出的话摆到那件事旁边，说给人听
意见：摆出去的那点想法本身
评价：同一动作，重在给出高下判断
words.recall_hint: com-（一起）+ ment（心、想）→ 琢磨出的话摆到那事旁边

words.root_logic: mergere（没入）→ 两样没进同一处，界线消失
words.origin: 拉丁语 mergere（浸入、没入）
words.native_definition: to combine two or more things into one
words.core_concept: two things going into one space until the line between is gone – 两样进到同一处，中间那条界线不见了
words.core_image: 两条车道并到一条上，前后车挤成一列，看不出原先各自走哪边
examples: The two banks merged last year.
semantic_expansions: 合并：两样并成一个，重在成一体
融合：界线彻底化掉，分不出各自
汇合：两股流到一处，重在流向合一
words.recall_hint: mergere（没入）→ 两样没进同一处，界线消失

words.root_logic: e-（出）+ merge（没入）→ 从没着的地方冒出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 emergere（浮出、露出）← e-（出）＋ mergere（没入）
words.native_definition: to come out from behind or below something and become visible
words.core_concept: breaking up out of what had covered it – 从盖着它的那层里冒上来
words.core_image: 雾散开一点，一个人从那片白里走出来，越来越清楚
examples: A figure emerged from the fog.
New facts emerged during the trial.
semantic_expansions: 出现/浮现：从盖着的那层里冒出来，被人看见
显露：原先看不出的部分露到面上
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ merge（没入）→ 从没着的地方冒出来

words.root_logic: im-（进入）+ merse（没入）→ 整个按进去，一点不露
words.origin: 拉丁语 immergere（浸入），过去分词 immersus ← in-（进）＋ mergere（没入）
words.native_definition: to put something completely into a liquid; to involve oneself deeply in an activity
words.core_concept: pushing a thing all the way under, no edge left out – 整个按到面下去，一个边都不留在外
words.core_image: 那块布被压进染缸，压到一个角都不露在外头
examples: Immerse the cloth in cold water.
He immersed himself in his work.
semantic_expansions: 浸没：整个按到液面下去
使沉浸/使专心：人整个进到一件事里，外头的事都进不来
words.recall_hint: im-（进入）+ merse（没入）→ 整个按进去，一点不露

words.root_logic: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）→ 装作认不出这件事 → 不予理会
words.origin: 拉丁语 ignorare（不认识、不理）← in-（不）＋ gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: to pay no attention to someone or something on purpose
words.core_concept: acting as though one does not recognize what is plainly there – 明明在那儿，却装作认不出
words.core_image: 桌上那封信摆了三天，他每次经过都不往那边看一眼
examples: She ignored him at the party.
semantic_expansions: 忽视：明知在那儿却不去看，重在不理会
不理：对人不作回应
无视：当作不存在，重在完全不放进眼里
words.recall_hint: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）→ 装作认不出那件事

words.root_logic: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）+ -ant（…的）→ 认不出、不晓得的
words.origin: 拉丁语 ignorans（不知的），ignorare 的现在分词 ← in-（不）＋ gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: lacking knowledge or awareness of something
words.core_concept: being the one who cannot recognize what others already do – 别人都认出来了，只有他认不出
words.core_image: 满桌人都在笑，只有他没听懂，也跟着笑了两声
examples: He is ignorant of the facts.
Don't be so ignorant about it.
semantic_expansions: 无知的：认不出、也没学过，重在缺知识
不知道的：这一件事上没被告知
愚昧的：长期认不出，带贬意
words.recall_hint: i-（不）+ gnor（认得出）+ -ant → 认不出那件事的

words.root_logic: nobilis（可认得出的、有名的）← gnoscere（认识）→ 众人都认得的那一家 → 出身高、品格高
words.origin: 古法语 noble ← 拉丁语 nobilis（有名的、显贵的）← gnoscere（认识）
words.native_definition: belonging to a high social class; having fine personal qualities
words.core_concept: the one whose name the whole room already knows – 名字一出口，满屋人都认得的那个
words.core_image: 他一报出姓氏，满屋人都停下来看他
examples: He came from a noble family.
semantic_expansions: 贵族的/贵族：众人都认得的那一家及其成员，即出身显贵
高尚的：由「众人认得、名声在外」转到品格上，够得上被称道
words.recall_hint: nobilis（可认得出的、有名的）← gnoscere（认识）→ 名字一出满屋人都认得

words.root_logic: de-（加重）+ ny（negare 说不）→ 一口咬定不是、不给
words.origin: 古法语 denier ← 拉丁语 denegare（坚决说不）← de-（加重）＋ negare（说不）
words.native_definition: to say that something is not true; to refuse to give something
words.core_concept: saying no to whatever is held out in front of one – 对递到面前的那件事说不
words.core_image: 照片摆到他面前，他看了两眼，说那不是他
examples: They were denied entry to the hall.
semantic_expansions: 否认：对一句陈述说不，说它不成立
拒绝：对一个请求说不，即不给
否定：对整件事说不，重在推翻
words.recall_hint: de-（加重）+ ny（说不）→ 一口咬定不是、不给

words.root_logic: deny（说不）+ -al（名词）→ 把「说不」这一下当作一件事
words.origin: 英语 denial，来自 deny ← 古法语 denier ← 拉丁语 denegare ← negare（说不）
words.native_definition: a statement that something is not true; a refusal to give something
words.core_concept: the act of saying no, taken as a thing in itself – 「说不」这一下本身，当成一件事看
words.core_image: 发布会上他只念了一句话就下台，说没有这回事
semantic_expansions: 否认/否定：说某事不成立这一下
拒绝：说不给这一下
words.recall_hint: deny（说不）+ -al → 把说不这一下当作一件事

words.root_logic: nega（说不）+ -tive（…性的）→ 站在说不那一边的
words.origin: 拉丁语 negativus（表否认的）← negare（说不）
words.native_definition: expressing refusal or disagreement; less than zero; showing that something is not present
words.core_concept: standing on the no side of the thing – 站在「不」那一边
words.core_image: 问他行不行，他每一条都摇头，一条都没点过头
semantic_expansions: 否定的：明确说不，与说是相对
负面的：说不那一边引申为坏的那一边
消极的：整个态度都偏在说不这边，不肯往前
阴性的：检验说「没有」，即那样东西不在
words.recall_hint: nega（说不）+ -tive → 站在说不那一边的

words.root_logic: nutrix（奶妈）← nutrire（喂养）→ 喂着、看着的那个人 → 照看病人的人
words.origin: 古法语 norrice（奶妈）← 晚期拉丁语 nutricia ← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: a person trained to care for sick people; to care for someone who is ill
words.core_concept: the one who feeds and watches over the helpless – 喂着、守着那个自己顾不了自己的人
words.core_image: 她一夜起了四回，换水、量体温，把药一口口送下去
examples: He nursed his wife for years.
semantic_expansions: 护士：喂药看护病人的那个人
保姆：早期义，喂养看顾小孩的那个人
照料：这个人所做的那件事本身
words.recall_hint: nutrix（奶妈）← nutrire（喂养）→ 喂着守着的那个人

words.root_logic: norrir（喂养）← nutrire（喂养）→ 供上它长起来要的东西
words.origin: 古法语 norriss-（norrir 的词干，喂养）← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: to give a living thing the food it needs to grow and stay healthy
words.core_concept: putting in what a living thing needs so it thickens and grows – 把活物长起来要的东西送进去
words.core_image: 盆里那株天天浇一遍，叶子一层层厚起来
examples: She nourished a hope of return.
semantic_expansions: 滋养：供上食物养分，使强健
养育：同一动作用在人身上，供着长大
怀有：把一个念头养着不断供着，久了不散
words.recall_hint: norrir（喂养）← nutrire（喂养）→ 供上长起来要的东西

words.root_logic: nutritura（喂养这件事）← nutrire（喂养）→ 一年年供着、看着，让它成形
words.origin: 古法语 norreture ← 晚期拉丁语 nutritura（喂养）← 拉丁语 nutrire（喂养）
words.native_definition: to care for and encourage the growth of someone or something
words.core_concept: the long feeding and tending that makes a thing turn out – 一年年供着照看，把它带成形
words.core_image: 那株苗从屋里搬到院里，浇水剪枝，几年后高过了墙
semantic_expansions: 培养：长期供着照看，使能力成形
养育：供吃供住带大，重在把人带起来
教养：这一路带下来在人身上留下的样子
words.recall_hint: nutritura（喂养）← nutrire → 一年年供着看着，让它成形

words.root_logic: lapsus（滑了一下）← labi（滑）→ 手一松滑开的那一下 → 小差错、失效
words.origin: 拉丁语 lapsus（滑倒、差错）← labi（滑）
words.native_definition: a small mistake or failure; a passing of time; to become no longer valid
words.core_concept: the small slip where the hold was let go – 握着的那一下松开，东西滑开
words.core_image: 话说到一半，那个名字忽然想不起来了
examples: He had a lapse of memory.
semantic_expansions: 失误：注意力滑开一下造成的小错
流逝：时间从手里一段段滑走
失效：约定滑出有效期，不再算数
间隔：两件事之间滑过去的那一段
words.recall_hint: lapsus（滑了一下）← labi（滑）→ 手一松滑开的那一下

words.root_logic: e-（出）+ lapse（滑）→ 一段时间从手里滑出去
words.origin: 拉丁语 elabi（溜走、滑出），过去分词 elapsus ← e-（出）＋ labi（滑）
words.native_definition: to pass by, said of a period of time
words.core_concept: a stretch of time sliding out and gone – 一段时候从手里滑出去，没留下痕迹
words.core_image: 抬头看钟，指针不知什么时候已经挪了两格
examples: Three hours elapsed before he woke.
Two weeks elapsed with no news.
semantic_expansions: 流逝/消逝：一段时候从手里滑出去、不再回来
words.recall_hint: e-（出）+ lapse（滑）→ 一段时候从手里滑出去

words.root_logic: col-（一起）+ lapse（滑）→ 各处一齐往下滑，整个下来
words.origin: 拉丁语 collapsus（一齐倒下），collabi 的过去分词 ← com-（一起）＋ labi（滑）
words.native_definition: to fall down suddenly; to fail completely
words.core_concept: every support letting go at the same moment – 各处支撑在同一刻一齐松开
words.core_image: 屋顶那几根梁一齐往下沉，整片瓦跟着落地，尘土腾起来
examples: The old bridge collapsed last night.
The company collapsed within a year.
semantic_expansions: 倒塌：各处一齐往下滑，房子整个下来
崩溃：同一画面用在人或系统上，撑不住了
垮台：一个组织或政权整个下来
瓦解：本来连着的各块一齐散开
words.recall_hint: col-（一起）+ lapse（滑）→ 各处一齐往下滑，整个下来

words.root_logic: mobile vulgus（易被推动的众人）的截短 ← movere（推动）→ 一推就动、拦不住的那群
words.origin: 英语 mob 是拉丁语短语 mobile vulgus（易动的民众）的截短 ← mobilis ← movere（移动、推动）
words.native_definition: a large disorderly crowd of people
words.core_concept: a crowd that shifts all at once when pushed – 被一推就整片挪动、各人不再自主的那群
words.core_image: 广场上人越挤越多，前排一喊，后面整片跟着往一个方向涌
examples: The mob broke the shop windows.
semantic_expansions: 暴民：一推就动、失了约束的那群人
乌合之众：临时凑起、没有主张的那群
一群人：中性用法，只取聚在一处这一层
words.recall_hint: mobile vulgus（易被推动的众人）的截短 ← movere（推动）

words.root_logic: mob（movere 移动）+ -ile（能…的）→ 挪得动的
words.origin: 拉丁语 mobilis（可移动的）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: able to move or be moved easily
words.core_concept: made so it can be shifted without taking it apart – 不用拆开就能挪走
words.core_image: 这台机器底下装了四个轮子，一个人推着就能换地方
examples: He works from a mobile office.
semantic_expansions: 移动的/可移动的：挪得动、不固定在一处
流动的：人或资源在各处之间挪得动
words.recall_hint: mob（移动）+ -ile（能…的）→ 挪得动的

words.root_logic: mobile（挪得动的）+ -ize（使…）→ 把停着的弄动起来
words.origin: 法语 mobiliser ← mobile ← 拉丁语 mobilis ← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: to organize people or resources so that they are ready to act
words.core_concept: getting what stood still to start moving together – 把原先停着的一齐弄动起来
words.core_image: 一通电话打出去，散在各处的人几小时内都到了场
examples: They mobilized support for the plan.
semantic_expansions: 动员：把人召起来投入行动
调动：把资源从各处挪到用得上的地方
组织起来：先编排再让其一齐动
words.recall_hint: mobile（挪得动的）+ -ize（使…）→ 把停着的弄动起来

words.root_logic: movimentum（动一下）← movere（移动）→ 天平偏一下的那一瞬 → 极短的一段
words.origin: 拉丁语 momentum（动的那一下、瞬间）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: a very short period of time; a particular point in time
words.core_concept: the single tip of the scale, over before it is named – 天平偏过去那一下，短到刚察觉就没了
words.core_image: 天平上添了一粒沙，指针偏了一下就停住了
examples: At that moment the lights went out.
semantic_expansions: 时刻：某件事发生的那一个点
瞬间：短到只够偏一下的那一段
片刻：同样短的一段，用在等待上
words.recall_hint: movimentum（动一下）← movere → 天平偏一下的那一瞬

words.root_logic: momentum（动的那一下）← movere（移动）→ 已经动起来的东西自带的那股劲
words.origin: 拉丁语 momentum（推动力、动量）← movere（移动）
words.native_definition: the force that a moving object has; the ability to keep making progress
words.core_concept: what a thing already in motion carries with it – 已经动起来的东西身上带着的那股劲
words.core_image: 球从坡上滚下来，越滚越快，伸手已经拦不住
semantic_expansions: 动量：物体因质量与速度带着的那股劲
势头：事情已经动起来、自己往前的那股劲
推动力：这股劲加在别的事上，把它带着走
words.recall_hint: momentum（动的那一下）← movere → 动起来的东西自带的那股劲

words.root_logic: magnus（大）+ -fy（使…）→ 使它看起来更大
words.origin: 拉丁语 magnificare（使变大、推崇）← magnus（大）＋ -ficare（使…，构词后缀）
words.native_definition: to make something appear larger; to make something seem more important than it is
words.core_concept: making the thing take up more space than it really does – 让那样东西占的地方比实际更大
words.core_image: 一片玻璃悬在纸上，底下的字撑满了整个圈
semantic_expansions: 放大：让它在眼里占的地方变大
夸大：同一动作用在事情的分量上，说得比实际重
words.recall_hint: magnus（大）+ -fy（使…）→ 使它显得更大

words.root_logic: maximus（最大的，magnus 的最高级）→ 到顶那一档，再上不去
words.origin: 拉丁语 maximum（最大之物），maximus（最大的）的中性形 ← magnus（大）
words.native_definition: the greatest amount or degree that is possible or allowed
words.core_concept: the line above which nothing more is allowed to go – 那一道刻线，越过去就不许了
words.core_image: 量杯侧面刻着一道线，水到那道就不能再添
examples: We need a maximum of ten people.
semantic_expansions: 最大量/最高限度：能到或允许到的那一档，再上不去
最大的：处在那一档上的
words.recall_hint: maximus（最大的）← magnus（大）→ 到顶那一档

words.root_logic: maior（更大的、居长的）→ 一城里位分最大的那个人
words.origin: 古法语 maire ← 拉丁语 maior（更大的、年长的）← magnus（大）
words.native_definition: the person elected to lead the government of a town or city
words.core_concept: the one who stands at the middle of the town's affairs – 一城的事上位分最大、站在正中的那个
words.core_image: 剪彩时他站在正中间，别人都退开半步
examples: The mayor opened the new bridge.
She was elected mayor last year.
semantic_expansions: 市长/镇长：一城或一镇里位分最大、主事的那个人
words.recall_hint: maior（更大的、居长的）→ 一城里位分最大的那个

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ ey（audire 听）→ 朝着那句话听，听了就照做
words.origin: 古法语 obeir ← 拉丁语 oboedire（听命）← ob-（朝向）＋ audire（听）
words.native_definition: to do what someone in authority tells you to do
words.core_concept: hearing the word and letting the body follow it – 那句话进了耳朵，身子就照着动
words.core_image: 话音刚落，队里的人一齐转向左边
semantic_expansions: 服从：对人照着做，不问自己愿不愿
遵守：对规则照着做
听从：重在把那句话听进去再照办
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ ey（听）→ 朝着那句话听，听完照做

words.root_logic: mes-（坏）+ chief（caput 头、结局）→ 事情落到坏的那一头
words.origin: 古法语 meschief（不幸、坏结局）← meschever ← mes-（坏）＋ chief（头、结局）← 拉丁语 caput（头）
words.native_definition: behaviour that causes small troubles or annoyance; harm or damage
words.core_concept: the way a thing turns out when it comes to a bad head – 一件事最后落到不好的那一头
words.core_image: 几个孩子把邻居的门牌拧反了，蹲在墙角看谁先发现
examples: The boys were up to mischief.
semantic_expansions: 恶作剧：故意闹出小乱子，让事情往坏的那头走
淘气：常做这类事的性子，分量轻
损害：真落到坏结局，即造成的实际坏处
words.recall_hint: mes-（坏）+ chief（头、结局）→ 事情落到坏的那一头

words.root_logic: ma（我的）+ dame（domina 女主人 ← domus 家）→ 我的女主人 → 对女子的敬称
words.origin: 法语 madame（我的夫人）← ma（我的）＋ dame ← 拉丁语 domina（女主人）← domus（家）
words.native_definition: a polite form of address used for a woman
words.core_concept: the courtesy word for the woman of the house – 对当家那位女子说话时先出口的那个称呼
words.core_image: 门口那人脱帽退开半步，先说了一句才让路
examples: Good evening, madame, this way please.
The letter was addressed to madame.
semantic_expansions: 夫人：把对方当作一家之主的女主人来称
女士/太太：同一敬称推广到一般场合
words.recall_hint: ma（我的）+ dame（女主人 ← 家）→ 对当家女子的称呼

words.root_logic: of-（朝、对着）+ fend（击）→ 一下撞到人身上
words.origin: 拉丁语 offendere（撞上、触犯）← ob-（朝向）＋ -fendere（击）
words.native_definition: to make someone feel upset or angry; to break a rule or law
words.core_concept: the blow that lands on the other instead of being kept off – 那一下没挡在外头，直接撞到对面身上
words.core_image: 那句话出口时对面的人脸色一沉，手里的杯子放下了
examples: I hope I didn't offend you.
semantic_expansions: 冒犯/得罪：话或举动撞到人身上，让人不快
违犯：同一动作撞到的是规则那条线
words.recall_hint: of-（朝、对着）+ fend（击）→ 一下撞到对面身上

words.root_logic: lega（结盟）← ligare（绑）→ 几方被一纸约绑在一起
words.origin: 意大利语 lega（同盟）← 拉丁语 ligare（捆、绑）；与 lex（法）无关
words.native_definition: a group of people or teams joined together by agreement; a level of quality
words.core_concept: several parties tied by one paper so they move as one – 几方被同一纸约系住，往后一起行动
words.core_image: 十几支队签了同一份章程，赛程和赏罚都照那张纸走
examples: He is in a different league.
semantic_expansions: 联盟/联合会：几方被一纸约系在一起的那个团体
等级：同一团体内按强弱分出的层，因而引申为水平档次
words.recall_hint: lega（结盟）← ligare（绑）→ 几方被一纸约绑在一起

words.root_logic: mēkhanē（装置）→ 几件零件配起来，通上力就替人做活
words.origin: 法语 machine ← 拉丁语 machina ← 希腊语 mēkhanē（装置、器械）
words.native_definition: a device with moving parts that uses power to do work
words.core_concept: parts fitted together and given power so the work happens – 零件配起来通上力，活就自己做成了
words.core_image: 皮带带着几个齿轮转，那只木箱被一点点抬了上去
semantic_expansions: 机器/机械：零件配成、通上力替人做活的那个东西
机构：一套人事像零件一样咬合运转，故借用同一画面
words.recall_hint: mēkhanē（装置）→ 零件配起来通上力就替人做活

words.root_logic: minutus（弄小了的）← minus（更小）→ 把整桌拆成一条条细列出来
words.origin: 法语 menu（详细清单）← 形容词 menu（细小的）← 拉丁语 minutus（弄小的）← minus（更小）
words.native_definition: a list of dishes available in a restaurant; a list of options on a screen
words.core_concept: the whole broken down into small single lines to pick from – 整个拆成细细一条条，供人一条条挑
words.core_image: 桌上那张纸从上到下印着一条条，每条后面跟一个数
examples: Ask the waiter for the menu.
Choose an item from the menu.
semantic_expansions: 菜单：一家馆子能做的菜细列成条
选单：屏上把可做的事细列成条，同一画面
words.recall_hint: minutus（弄小的）← minus（更小）→ 拆成一条条细列出来

words.root_logic: nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）→ 还是出生时那个样子，没被世事改过
words.origin: 法语 naïf / naïve（天生的、朴质的）← 拉丁语 nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）
words.native_definition: showing a lack of experience, so believing things too easily
words.core_concept: still just as one came into the world, untouched by dealings – 还是出生时那个样子，没被世事磨过
words.core_image: 别人说什么她都点头，钱都递过去了才觉出不对
examples: She was naive to trust him.
semantic_expansions: 天真的：还保持着出生时那样，未经世事
幼稚的：同样的状态，但已到了该懂事的年纪
轻信的：因为没经历过，别人说什么都照单收下
words.recall_hint: nativus（天生的）← nasci（出生）→ 还是出生时那个样子

words.root_logic: ob-（迎面）+ vi（via 路）+ -ous（…的）→ 横在路当中的 → 谁走过都看得见
words.origin: 拉丁语 obvius（迎面挡在路上的）← ob-（朝向）＋ via（路）
words.native_definition: easy to see or understand because it is right in front of you
words.core_concept: the thing lying across the road, which no passer-by can miss – 横在路当中，走过的人一个也躲不开
words.core_image: 路当中横着一块大石头，走这条路的人没一个能绕开没看见
examples: The answer was obvious to everyone.
semantic_expansions: 明显的/显而易见的：横在路当中，谁走过都看得见
words.recall_hint: ob-（迎面）+ vi（路）+ -ous → 横在路当中，谁走过都看得见
